description: CTSM (CLM) boundary traces from an instrumented I-class CESM run (compset I2000Clm60Sp = 2000_DATM%GSWP3v1_CLM60%SP_SICE_SOCN_MOSART_DGLC%NOEVOLVE_SWAV). Default-gated by dump_clm=.false. and enabled in this run only. FIRST SLICE, prioritizing the urban (CLMU) / radiation / surface-energy path so the existing (unverified) EarthSciModels CLMU can be checked against real CESM: (a) D-boundary pointwise laws - the saturation specific humidity law QSat(T,p); the urban albedo law (UrbanAlbedo: per-surface reflected/absorbed solar + albedos); the urban longwave canyon law (UrbanRadiation/net_longwave: net+upward longwave per roof/road/wall); the urban canyon turbulent-transfer boundary (UrbanFluxes exit); the ground surface albedo (SurfaceAlbedo: soil/snow/ground albedo); the two-stream absorbed/reflected shortwave partition (SurfaceRadiation); the bare-ground turbulent-flux boundary (BareGroundFluxes); and the soil/surface energy-balance boundary (SoilFluxes). PET 0 only, first dump_first_cols points of each filter x first dump_first_steps steps, OMP-critical writes, EqIce-style CSV headers.

w2.indexing_bug: ROOT-CAUSED + FIXED (clm 2d8e0c697): gfortran passes whole arrays and associate names to assumed-shape dummies as 1-based POSITIONAL views, so a dummy declared (:,:) reads memory position j for dummy index j regardless of the actual's dim2 lower bound. The first W2 run therefore showed snow at j=4..12 (the true snow layers at memory -8..0 read via positions), garbage rows at j=-8..0 (OOB reads that coincidentally matched finidat slots 29..37), and W1 clm_soilfluxes t_soisno_1..3 = 0 (unused snow slots -11..-9 instead of the top soil layers). Fix: declare every 2-D dummy with an explicit dim2 lower bound -nlevsno+1 (positional correspondence then maps dummy index j to true memory j). Proven by a standalone gfortran reproducer (/scratch.local/ctessum/assoctest/t.f90) and by the regenerated CSVs matching finidat exactly: entry(step 1) T_SOISNO for c=1 and c=14 equals finidat_interp_dest.nc slots 4..37 to 34/34 layers (slot s <-> memory index s-12).
w2.header_order_defect: The first W2 clm_soiltemp '# columns' header listed qflx_snomelt_lyr,qflx_snofrz_lyr before h2osoi_liq,h2osoi_ice while the data emits h2osoi first (x(10)/x(11) before x(12)/x(13)); fixed in 2d8e0c697 (header reordered to match data; desc updated). Required one rebuild + rerun (LID 261102-004337).
w2.layer_convention: soiltemp rows use the MODEL layer index j: snow layers snl+1..0 (negative), soil layers 1..jbot (positive, jbot=nlevgrnd=25 here; nlevsno=12, levtot=37). The file/restart slot for layer j is j+nlevsno (proven via restart iodesc and finidat/restart T_SOISNO agreement). The earlier 'h2osoi NaN at step-1 entry' observation was a mislabel artifact of the header-order defect; with correct columns h2osoi is valid at every entry.
w2.snow_interstep: exit(step N) != entry(step N+1) for SNOW layers only (up to 4e-3 K, ~4% of snow pairs; columns 11-15 in this run) is designed model behavior, not a defect: between SoilTemperature calls, HydrologyNoDrainage adds snowfall to the top layer (UpdateState_AddNewSnow), Sublimation/evap on the top layer, DivideSnowLayers sheds the top layer's excess above snow_dzmax_u_1=0.02 m down the pack as a cascade (each layer sitting at its dzmax_u limit sheds a proportional slice into the layer below; mass-weighted Combo retemperatures the receiver - reproduced analytically to ~3%: predicted layer-7/8 gains +0.0219/+0.0462 kg/m2 vs traced +0.0225/+0.0477), and SnowCapping trims the excess above h2osno_max=10000 kg/m2 (10 m WE, this build's default) from the bottom snow layer. Deep snowpacks in this run sit exactly at both limits. Soil layers are continuous to 0.0 K.
w2.e_drop_note: gfortran es26.17 writes exponents <= -100 without the 'E' (e.g. '-1.23456789012345679-101'); verified this affects only header rows in these CSVs (no data row has an exponent <= -100), so no reformatting was needed.
w2.soilfluxes_w1_note: The W1 clm_soilfluxes t_soisno_1..3 values in the first W2-era runs (jobs 11971155 / 11967609 pre-fix LID 261102-001619) were affected by the same gfortran rebase (read 0 from unused snow slots -11..-9); from clm 2d8e0c697 + rerun LID 261102-004337 they are the top three soil-layer temperatures (model layers 1..3).

w3.soiltemp_extension: clm 1c0d375dd: dump_soiltemp gains the soil texture parameters (tkmg/tkdry/watsat/csol per soil layer), nbedrock and frac_sno_fluxes (= frac_sno_eff) per column, the ComputeGroundHeatFluxAndDeriv outputs (hs_top_snow, hs_soil, dhsdT, sabg_lyr_col) and the interface heat diffusion fn at the exit stage, and emits BOTH layer interfaces per row: zi_top = zi(j-1) and zi_bot = zi(j). This fixes the pre-W3 zi labelling defect (see w2.zi_labelling). SoilTemperatureMod.F90 call sites pass soilstate_inst%tkmg/tkdry/watsat/csol, col%nbedrock and frac_sno_fluxes at both stages. NOTE: the fork checkout is shared with the concurrent clm-surfalbedo lane; its clm commit 3d7038304 (surfalbedo albsnd/albsni + soil color + h2osoi_vol_1 columns) is the parent of 1c0d375dd and was committed while the W3 run was in flight, so 3d7038304's clm_dump_mod.F90 diff contains BOTH lanes' dump changes.

w3.zi_labelling_defect: The pre-W3 clm_soiltemp.csv zi column was mislabelled: it carried the interface ABOVE layer j (zi(c,j-1)), not 'the interface below layer j'. Root cause: col%zi is allocated with dim2 lower bound -nlevsno+0 (-12) while the dump dummy declared -nlevsno+1 (-11), so gfortran's positional view shifted every read down one interface. W3 declares the dummy -nlevsno+0 and emits zi_top/zi_bot with their true indices. The pre-W3 pins in clm_canopy.esm are unaffected (they read t_soisno/h2osoi only).

veg.description: Vegetated-patch lane (clm afbae49dd on top of 65f12f0d8): dynamic per-step top-N selection of the most-vegetated patches for four new CSVs - clm_canopyflux_veg.csv (CanopyFluxes vegetated-branch exit boundary: leaf-temperature iteration num_iter/det/dele, canopy storage update at the end of CanopyFluxes), clm_twostream.csv (TwoStream canopy radiation law, coszen>0 patches only; sun/shade absorption vis only), clm_interception.csv (CanopyInterceptionAndThroughfall entry/hyd rows: fpiliq/fpisnow, throughfall, intercepted fluxes, liqcan/snocan update, fwet/fcansno/fdry), clm_soilwater.csv (SoilWater solve entry/exit per selected column).
veg.selection: dump_veg_patches=16. Writer PET chosen ONCE at the first dump_select_veg call (step 1) by two integer allreduces over the CLM communicator: max qualifying-patch count (frac_veg_nosno=1, elai+esai>0, liqcan+snocan>0), tie-break lowest PET. On this cold start every PET has nveg=0 at step 1 (liqcan+snocan==0 everywhere), so all PETs tie at nvegmax=0 and the tie-break picks PET 0. Each traced step the writer PET ranks its qualifying patches by elai+esai (desc), then liqcan+snocan (desc), then patch index, keeps the top 16 and traces them in all four files. Traced steps are 2..12 (step 1 qualifies nothing on a cold start), i.e. 11 steps x 16 patches = 176 rows in canopyflux_veg and interception (ent+hyd), 92 twostream rows (daylit subset), 318 soilwater rows = entry/exit pairs for 15 distinct selected columns on steps 2..5 and 12 and 14 on steps 6..11 (the number of distinct columns of the top-16 patches varies with the selection).

run.soilwater_movement_method: 1 (moisture_form) in this case: the zengdecker2009 hk loop in SoilWaterMovementMod never runs, so clm_soilwater.csv carries entry/exit rows only and the hk-law columns (vwc_liq..dsmpdw) are NaN; the validator skips the hk-law checks (documented in README-clm-veg.md). The moisture_form solve itself is not traced (its per-layer flux loop lives in a different routine); if a moisture_form solve trace is wanted later it can be added without touching this lane's files.

veg.bugs_found_this_lane: Two instrumentation bugs fixed during bring-up (not CLM physics): (1) controlMod control_spmd never mpi_bcast the five dump_* namelist variables, so only PET 0 read them while PETs 1..35 returned early from dump_select_veg, deadlocking PET 0's writer-PET allreduce; (2) shr_mpi_min cannot alias its in/inout buffers (MPI_ALLREDUCE), so the non-writer branch reduced through a temp. Also SurfaceAlbedoMod had dump_twostream inside 'if (use_SSRE)' (never fired; moved after the main TwoStream call). The 'layer, h2osoi_liq: 182 2 -20.878' debug print (SoilWaterMovementMod:1422) and step-1 balance warnings are pre-existing baseline behavior, deterministic and identical in both runs.
veg.step_order_note: Empirically verified step order within a model step: CanopyHydrology (interception) -> CanopyFluxes -> SurfaceAlbedo; the canopyflux_veg rows carry the POST-evap liqcan/snocan (end-of-CanopyFluxes update at lines 1618-1635: if t_veg>tfrz, liqcan = max(0, liqcan+(tran-evap)*dtime), snocan raid when (evap-tran)*dtime > liqcan; mirror below tfrz; then truncate_small_values), while the interception hyd rows carry the PRE-evap values.
